correctness.rationale: Distances: 2 between distinct vertices in the same bipartition, 1 incident, 3 nonincident. BB^T=qI+J on points/lines and B1=(q+1)1 give complete powered-distance eigenspaces on the centered hyperplane: color-antisymmetric q(q+1)2^p-(q+1)-q²3^p always negative, transverse -2^p±sqrt(q)(3^p-1), each multiplicity v-1. The plus branch crosses zero uniquely in (0,1), yielding exact critical equation and equality kernel (-By/sqrt(q),y), y centered; centered Schoenberg Gram rank drops from 2v-1 to v. Verified Fano plane BB^T identity by constructing mod-2 incidence, all 14² graph distances, and direct eigenvalues below/at/above p=0.694280092777. Taylor implicit-function expansion and strict q-monotonicity checked algebraically. No assumption of planes existing for all q and no minimal-support claim.
residual_risks: Schoenberg theorem and incidence eigenvalues are classical; an older general distance-regular scheme treatment may contain this special closed formula.
